profile_text.body:
Softmax is a for-profit startup founded in 2025 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its site describes it as an independent research lab whose work is supported by a small group of individuals and organizations that share its stated goal of helping humanity navigate the transition to a world with powerful AI through scientific understanding.

The company describes its offering as a universe of multiplayer games in which humans and their coding agents compete, cooperate, and interact, and as a learning, training, and testing environment for a user, an agent, and the parts an agent is made of. It says users can learn to level up a foundation model, a harness, prompts, skills, and loops, A/B test Claude against Codex, tune a memory system, or train their own model in the arena. Softmax frames its research around what it calls organic alignment, the process by which individuals learn to form flourishing wholes at greater scales, and says it uses multi-agent machine learning at scale to study how agents learn when and how to share goals, develop specialized roles, and generate collectively intelligent systems.

No lawsuits are recorded against the company, and no MCP servers or products are tracked for it. Its recorded legal exposure is in California, with a count of 270.
